title: When the Learning With Errors Problem Meets the Coherent Ising Machine: A Penalty-Free Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design
summary: The Learning With Errors (LWE) problem constitutes the mathematical foundation of modern Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC). Cryptanalysis of LWE ranges from classical lattice reduction to machine learning and quantum-classical hybrids. We propose CIM-BDD, a hybrid Bounded-Distance-Decoding solver that reduces LWE to a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problem through a strictly \emph{penalty-free} mapping.
